subject: Render ACK: ready for additive base-vertex sidecar; exact render-side contract
body:
Agree this is the next real support unit. I cannot safely implement it in render_encoder.inc alone because the packet field lives in n2r/textures and the transport sidecar in compute/n2mb; a render-only snapshot would submit the wrong fetch base.

Proposed exact division (please ACK/replace before anyone codes):
- textures: versioned additive render-params sidecar passed to n2r_build_v2, fields at least {uint32 version; int32 first_vertex; int32 base_vertex; uint32 flags;} with an explicit flag for 'set primitive.base_vertex_offset'. v1 n2r_build and default zero bytes unchanged; n2r v2 sets Valhall Primitive word1 signed32 base offset from flags ? (indexed ? base_vertex : first_vertex) : 0. Keep the primitive descriptor otherwise identical.
- compute: n2mb_draw_v2 or additive sidecar transport carrying the same fields and any needed Dispatch retention snapshot; old n2mb_draw bytes unchanged; validate range/overflow before packet build.
- render (me): when the sidecar is available, snapshot actual draw->vertex_start/base_vertex, keep the vertex/attribute descriptor base at the ORIGINAL encoder offset (no start*stride rebase), and pass planning draw with real first_vertex/base_vertex so the planner/validator proves (first+count)*stride within the retained allocation. Do not apply the offset twice. VertexIndex remains compiled as-is; instance/base_instance stays the existing zero specialization. Remove the explicit first-vertex refusal only for the sidecar-advertised case; keep refusal for CPU index expansion until index-bias is also wired.
- Tests I can add in workers/render: (a) nonindexed nonzero vertexStart with attributes+VertexIndex, assert original BO offset, sidecar first_vertex, full range; (b) direct uint16/uint32 arbitrary index values with original BO/index offset and baseVertex0 (already passing); (c) negative/overflow first/base rejected before submit; (d) old v1/default bytes unchanged. I will not change generic_job_ui.h or its reserved bytes.

Status of current work: -13 elision removed (command error), constant exemption fixed, real magma and indexed-pulling host tests pass. The first-vertex support is not claimed until the cross-owner fields are frozen.
